From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference>
To: Sam Lin <sam.lin@acmehealth.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood Inference / AcmeHealth

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Quick recap from our discovery and the next steps on security/compliance so we can get the SIG moving: 

- Redwood status: SOC 2 Type II report completed Mar 2027 (available under NDA). We support GDPR controls and offer HIPAA-capable deployments (BAA available for production Private/Dedicated).
- Data handling: Hosted API retains request metadata for billing/ops; customer data controls and retention are configurable for Dedicated/Private.
- Encryption: Supports provider-managed encryption for Hosted; KMS/BYOK options for Dedicated and Private.

Requests / next steps:
1) If you can confirm the scope (production vs. sandbox/dev) for the questionnaire that will help us prioritize which docs to attach.
2) I've attached our suggested SIG template to speed the kickoff (redwood_sig_template_v2.xlsx). If you prefer your XLSX version, send it back and we'll start filling.
3) Please let us know your security contact for follow-ups and whether you need the SOC 2 bundle (NDA required).

Open clarifying questions from your team we noticed during the call:
- Will the scope include our sandbox/test clusters? (affects retention/config answers)
- Do you need a current subprocessor list and data flow diagram?

I'm cc'ing Marissa (security) and Rafael (technical) who can jump in on any deep technical clarifications.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.inference

Camila —

Thanks for the recap. We'd like to proceed and scope this to production systems (we'll exclude sandbox for now). A few items from our security team to get started: 

- Could you confirm whether the SOC 2 Type II report can be shared under NDA and how quickly (we can sign an NDA).
- We need an up-to-date subprocessor list and the most recent vulnerability/pen test summary.
- Encryption question: For Hosted API, are encryption keys managed by your cloud provider or can we bring our own KMS?

I'm attaching our standard SIG XLSX so you can start filling the sections we discussed. If you can pre-populate the SOC/TLS/encryption and subprocessor sections that'll save time. Our security lead (Priya) will review once you send back.

Sam

Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Redwood Inference / AcmeHealth

Hi Sam / Priya —

Great — production scope noted. Answers to your bullets below: 

- SOC 2: We completed SOC 2 Type II in March 2027. We can share the full SOC 2 bundle under a mutual NDA; I've attached our standard NDA to accelerate (Redwood_NDA_v1.pdf). If you confirm we'll execute and provide the report within 48 business hours after signing.

- Subprocessors & pen test: I've attached our current subprocessor list (Redwood_Subprocessors.csv). We run regular 3rd-party pen tests and can provide an executive summary; full pentest artifacts can be shared under SCO/contractual terms — Rafael can coordinate specifics.

- Encryption: For Hosted API (our managed offering) we use cloud-provider-managed keys by default. For Dedicated and Private deployments we support customer KMS / BYOK (we can integrate with AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, or GCP KMS). If you need envelope encryption or HSM-backed keys for production, Rafael can follow up with implementation notes.

- Data residency & retention: We support region pinning for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted, we can discuss contractual data residency constraints if required; retention settings are configurable per-tenant for log and cache TTLs.

Next steps I propose:
1) Please confirm acceptance of the NDA (attached) so we can share SOC 2 bundle.
2) We'll start populating the SIG you attached and send back a draft within 3 business days.
3) Rafael will be available for a quick call if your team wants a technical walkthrough of encryption/subprocessors.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.inference

[Attachment: Redwood_Subprocessors.csv (text/csv)]
[Attachment: Redwood_NDA_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

Camila —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. We'll route the NDA to our legal team and target signing by EOD Mon 17 May. Once we have the NDA in place, please send the SOC 2 bundle.

We'll have Priya and her team review the SIG you'll populate — can you flag the sections you'd like us to prioritize (encryption, subprocessors, access controls, incident response)? If you can return a prefilled draft by next Thursday 20 May, that would work for our timeline.

I'll loop in Priya for scheduling a short technical call with Rafael if needed. Thanks again — looking forward to the draft.

Best,
Sam
